text:
```yaml
name: Publish to npm

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org/

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Authenticate to npm
        run: echo "//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}" >> ~/.npmrc

      - name: Publish to npm
        run: npm publish --access public
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file `.github/workflows/publish.yml` automates the process of publishing the `aspipes` package to npm. It runs on both GitHub releases being published and manual triggers via `workflow_dispatch`. The workflow includes steps to checkout the code, set up Node.js, install dependencies, run tests, authenticate to npm using the `NPM_TOKEN` secret, and finally publish the package with public access.
